blocks.content: What we just saw is prop drilling: passing a value through components that don't personally need it, just so a deeper component can get it.
With React Router, the problem escalates. Notice that we are writing element={<HomePage theme={theme} />} for every single route.
If we add a new page, we have to remember to pass theme there too. If we forget, that page renders without the correct theme and silently breaks.
Now imagine Header also needs toggleTheme(). And EntryDetailPage needs toggleTheme(). And NotFoundPage decides it wants to respect the theme too.
Every new consumer means updating App.jsx and every intermediate component.
That's not good, and there's a better way, which is to use contexts.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
